Faboo Banana Fritters
By: Heidela
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 10:26am

Ingredients




Over-ripe Bananas

Whole wheat flour

Vegetable oil

Cinnamon

Nutmeg

Powdered sugar

Preparation

1 Mash ripe bananas with cinnamon & nutmeg. 2 Add 1.5 TB whole wheat flour per banana, and continue to mash, until the consistency feels like cookie batter. 3 Spoon the mixture into an oiled & well-heated pan. 4 Fry on each side until golden brown. 5 Sprinkle powdered sugar on, & serve.
